name: fastify
description: A self-operated Fastify API server — Fastify 5 + PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM + the Zod type provider. Plugin encapsulation sets the structure.

notes.securityBoundary: The application layer is the only boundary — the DB is reached over a trusted connection, so nothing leans on row-level policy. The trap specific to this axis is **plugin encapsulation**: attach a route outside the plugin context that registered the `onRequest` auth hook and that route never receives the hook. The authentication method (self-issued JWT · session · external IdP) is undecided, so it is a question to confirm
notes.serverCodeLocation: The API server in this repository. Even when the frontend axis has a server runtime (Next.js, etc.), API ownership sits here
notes.toolchain: The language and package manager are often the same as the frontend's, so monorepos are common. A single Zod schema doubles as request validation, response serialization, and the shared contract
notes.variants: The prebuilt pack backend/fastify pins Fastify 5 + Drizzle — a different ORM (Prisma etc.) takes the generation path. Pick Express and backend/node-api owns that shape; NestJS, backend/node-nest; a finished Hono + AWS setup, backend/aws-container
